title: Stocks Fell 6 Days in a Row. Is a Crash Coming?
description:
The S&P 500 fell 6 days in a row and closed at 7,175.83 on Nov 19, 2026: 8.2% below its Oct 6 record of 7,818.93. The Nasdaq is 13.5% below its record (a correction) and the Dow closed at 49,097.06, below 50,000 for the first time since June. Why: the 10-year Treasury yield is 5.07%, inflation is 4.1%, and the Fed raised rates in September. Then the history: since 1950 the S&P 500 fell 8% or more from a record 37 times, and 11 of those became bear markets. After 116 six-day losing streaks, stocks were higher a year later 91 of 116 times.
